αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἵματι: αἷμα — blood; neut. dat. sg.: ’with blood’, instrumental
αὐτοὺς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ (grave, mid-clause form) · also intensive, masc. acc. pl., in apposition: ’themselves’ (καὶ αὐτοὺς Ἀργείους ’the Argives themselves’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’ourselves’ (αὐτοὺς … ὑπεκφυγέειν ’ourselves to flee’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’ · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with no preposition, indirect object: ’to him’ (ἥρμοσε … αὐτῷ ’fitted him’)
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, idly, without more; adv.: ’merely, to no purpose’ · also in ὣς δ’ αὔτως, ’in the same way’: ’likewise’
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτέ: αὖτε — again, now in turn; adv., accented αὖτέ before the enclitic μιν
βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, hit; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαλε): ’hit, struck’ · also ’let fall, droop’ (κάρη βάλεν ’lets its head fall’)
βέβληαι: βάλλω — throw, hit; perf. pass. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic βέβλησαι): ’you have been hit’
βέλος: βέλος — missile, shaft, arrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
βαθείης: βαθύς — deep; fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
βαλὼν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, striking’
βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ’good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)
γίγνεται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen, arise; pres. 3 sg.: ’comes into being, grows’
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic γαίας)
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic γαίᾳ)
γαῖαν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαφυρῇσιν: γλαφυρός — hollow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
γνὺξ: γνύξ — on the knees, kneeling; adv.: ’on his knees’
γυναικὸς: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. gen. sg., with ἐϋζώνοιο: ’of the well-girdled woman’, after χωόμενον · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀντί: ’in place of a woman’
γυναῖκες: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. nom. pl.: ’women’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δήμου: δῆμος — people, common folk (also the land of a people); masc. gen. sg.: δήμου ἄνδρα ’a man of the people’
δίφρον: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. acc. sg. · also a seat, stool: ’stool’ (δίφρον … κατέθηκε ’set down a stool’)
δίφρόν: δίφρος — chariot (the car); masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
δαναοὺς: Δαναοί — the Danaans, one of Homer’s names for the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
δαρδανίδαο: Δαρδανίδης — descendant of Dardanus, a Trojan; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου), with Πριάμοιο
δεινόν: δεινός — terrible, dread, awesome; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’dreadfully’
διομήδης: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’)
διῒ: Ζεύς — Zeus; dat. sg., epic Διΐ (= Διί); Διῒ φίλος ’dear to Zeus’
δοιοῖσιν: δοιοί (= δύο) — two; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς), with ἀριστήεσσιν
δολιχόσκιον: δολιχόσκιος — long-shadowed; neut. acc. sg., epithet of a spear (ἔγχος)
δουρί: δόρυ — spear, shaft; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δόρατι)
δουρικλειτὸς: δουρικλειτός — famed for the spear; masc. nom. sg., epithet of a warrior (δόρυ + κλειτός, = δουρικλυτός)
δουρικλυτὸς: δουρικλυτός — famed for the spear (δόρυ + κλυτός); masc. nom. sg., epithet of a warrior
δουρὶ: δόρυ — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δορί)
δοῦπον: δοῦπος — thud, booming sound; masc. acc. sg.
δόλων: Δόλων — Dolon, son of Eumedes, a Trojan; masc. nom. sg. (a name, not δόλος ’trick’)
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable · also δύω — go into, put on (armour); aor. subj. 1 sg. act., short-vowel subj. after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’I put on’ (τεύχεα δύω)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom · also εἰ γάρ + opt., introducing a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ γὰρ … εἴην ’if only I were’) · also εἰ γὰρ δή + indic.: ’if indeed’ (εἰ γὰρ δὴ μέματον ’if you two are indeed eager’)
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἵποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., with the augment εἱ- (from ἐ-σεπ-): ’followed’
εἶπε: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., without movable ν (= Attic εἶπεν)
εἶσι: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg. (neut. pl. subject with a sing. verb): ’go forth’
εἷος: εἷος — while, until (epic, = Attic ἕως); conj., correlative with τόφρα: ’while’
εὐχόμενος: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, boast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’praying’ · also ’boasting’, of a claim
εὔχεαι: εὔχομαι — claim, profess, boast; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὔχῃ)
εὔχεσθαι: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. inf. mid./dep.
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θήν: θήν — surely, indeed; epic enclitic particle (= Attic δήπου)
θαλεροί: θαλερός — blooming, lusty, vigorous; masc. nom. pl., with αἰζηοί
θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θεράπων: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. nom. sg.
θυμοῦ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; masc. gen. sg.
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul, anger; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ἀποπνείων ’breathing out his life’)
θυμός: θυμός — life, the life-breath that leaves the body; also heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θώρηκα: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. acc. sg., epic θώρηκ- (= Attic θώρακα)
θῦνε: θύνω — rush, dart; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθυνε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’rush’ (θῦνε διὰ προμάχων ’rush through the front-fighters’)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’
κίεν: κίω — go; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (κίε(ν) = Attic ᾔει)
καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, down to; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing (καθ’ ἕδρας ’down to their seats’) · also + acc., ’through, throughout’ (καθ’ ὕλην ’through the wood’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (καθ’ ἵππων) · also + acc., ’according to’ (καθ’ ἡμέτερον νόον ’according to our mind’)
κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg. used as a noun in apposition to a person: ’an evil, a bane’ (τυκτὸν κακόν ’a fashioned evil’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. agreeing with θυμόν: ’evil’
κακότητος: κακότης — wickedness, evil; fem. gen. sg., gen. of the wrong avenged: ’for the wickedness’
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate noun: ’an evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., adj. with ὄναρ: ’evil (dream)’
καλόν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with ἐστί understood and an inf.: ’a fine thing (to …)’
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, down along; + gen./acc.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατ’ … ἕζετο = καθέζετο ’sat down’) · also κατ’ ἔμ’ αὐτόν ’by myself, alone’ (κατά + acc.) · also κατ’ αἶσαν ’according to due measure, rightly’ (κατά + acc.) · also + acc., ’upon, against’ (κατ’ ἀσπίδα ’on the shield’) · also + acc., ’over’ (κατ’ ὄσσε ’over the eyes’)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’) · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε σήκασθεν ’would have been penned’) · also + opt. in a condition after εἰ: ’if … might’ · also εἰς ὅ κε + aor. subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … εὕρωμεν ’until we find’) · also ἤ κε … ἦ κε + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’
κεκλήγων: κλάζω — shriek, cry loudly; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -ων (= κεκληγώς), present sense: ’shrieking’
κεκλιμένος: κλίνω — lean, recline; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’lying, resting’
κελαινὴ: κελαινός — dark, black; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with νύξ: ’dark’
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’ · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κεν ἔλθητον ’so that you two may come’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’as long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν ὁρᾷ ’as long as he sees’)
κενεῶνα: κενεών — flank, the hollow of the body between ribs and hip; masc. acc. sg., acc. of the part struck
κεφαλῆφιν: κεφαλή — head; fem. sg. with the epic suffix -φιν, locative or instrumental (= Attic dat. κεφαλῇ): ’on the head’ · also with ἀπό, separative: ’from the head’
κιχείω: κιχάνω — come upon, find, overtake; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic
κλυτὰ: κλυτός — famous, renowned; neut. acc. pl., with δώματ’
κλυτὸν: κλυτός — famous, renowned, glorious; masc. acc. sg.
κονίῃσι: κονία — dust; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κονίαις)
κρατερὸς: κρατερός — mighty, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg.
κρατερῶς: κρατερῶς — mightily, strongly, forcefully; adv. from κρατερός
κρονίων: Κρονίων — son of Cronus, Zeus; masc. nom. sg., by-form of Κρονίδης
κυλίνδεται: κυλίνδω — roll; pres. 3 sg. mid.-pass.: ’rolls, comes rolling on’
κύον: κύων — dog; masc./fem. voc. sg., a term of abuse
κὰκ: κατά (apocope κὰκ before κ-) — down; prep. + acc. of the place struck: ’down on, on’ (κὰκ κορυφήν ’on the crown’) · also + gen., ’down from’
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg.; as accusative of respect, χωόμενος κῆρ ’incensed in heart’ · also κήρ — doom, death-fate; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’
κῆρα: κήρ — doom, fate of death; fem. acc. sg.
κῆρες: κήρ — death-spirit, doom of death; fem. nom. pl.: ’the death-spirits’ (a different word from κῆρ ’heart’)
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
λευκὸν: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάχην: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg., object of καταδύμεναι: ’the fighting’ · also fem. acc. sg., after ἀνά (ἄν τε μάχην): ’through the fighting’
μάχῃ: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. dat. sg.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg.
μέλανος: μέλας — black, dark; masc. gen. sg., with θανάτοιο · also masc. gen. sg., with κυάνοιο: ’black’ (μέλανος κυάνοιο ’of black κύανος’)
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’) · also μένω — stay, stand firm; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stand!’ (ἠὲ μέν’ ’either stand’)
μένοντες: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’waiting’
μέροπος: Μέροψ — Merops of Percote, a seer; masc. gen. sg.
μέσσοισι: μέσος — middle, mid; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι with double σ (= Attic μέσοις); ἐν μέσσοισι ’in the midst’
μαντοσύνας: μαντοσύνη — seer’s craft, prophecy; fem. acc. pl., Ionic -ας, object of ᾔδεε
μεγαλήτορα: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’great-hearted’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis · also + acc. in μετὰ νῶτα βαλών: ’behind, with the back turned’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μοῦνος: μόνος (epic/Ionic μοῦνος) — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’) · also a pledge, promise (τὸν μῦθον ὑπέστημεν ’the promise we undertook’)
νείατον: νείατος — lowest, last; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic νέατος)
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνόησε): ’noticed’
νύξεν: νύσσω — prick, thrust at, stab; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔνυξε): ’thrust at’
νῶϊν: ἐγώ — I; dual gen./dat., epic (= Attic νῷν): ’for us two’
οἰώθη: οἰόομαι — be left alone, be left solitary; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was left alone’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον) · also encl. dat. sg. οἱ, accented before a following enclitic: ’to him’ (δέ οἵ ἐστ’ ’and his … is’)
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’; masc. acc. pl. (οὓς παῖδας ’his own sons’)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτασε: οὐτάω — wound (by a thrust), stab; aor. 3 sg. act.
οὔτασεν: οὐτάω — wound by a thrust; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’wounded’
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
παλαιοῦ: παλαιός — old, ancient; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ἴλου
παναίολον: παναίολος — all-glancing, all-gleaming (πᾶν + αἰόλος ’flashing, quick’); adj., masc. acc. sg.
παχείῃ: παχύς — thick, stout, strong; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic παχείᾳ)
παῖδας: παῖς — child, son; masc. acc. pl.
παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
πεζὸς: πεζός — on foot; adj., masc. nom. sg.
πειθέσθην: πείθομαι — obey, trust (+ dat.); impf. 3 dual mid., unaugmented (= ἐπειθέσθην): ’the two obeyed’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περκωσίου: Περκώσιος — of Percote; masc. gen. sg., with Μέροπος
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’)
πεσὼν: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (aor. stem πεσ-): ’having fallen’
πληθύν: πληθύς — crowd, throng, mass of men; fem. acc. sg.
πληθὺν: πληθύς — throng, crowd, multitude; fem. acc. sg.: μετὰ πληθύν ’through the throng’
ποδὸς: πούς — foot; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the part seized: ’by the foot’
ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, surely’
προΐει: προΐημι — send forth, send off; impf. 3 sg. (προΐει, diaeresis marking the separate syllable)
προμάχων: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. gen. pl.
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσεφώνεεν: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεφώνει)
πρόσθ: πρόσθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., elided πρόσθ’ (= πρόσθε): ’before (the others)’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πόνοιο: πόνος — toil, labour, work; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of what is lost after ἀποσφήλειε
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, bane; neut. acc. sg., in apposition to the whole action · also neut. nom. sg., subject of λίποιτο: ’a woe (be left)’
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
σήμερον: σήμερον — today, this day; adv. (Attic τήμερον)
σεύωνται: σεύω — drive, hunt; mid. rush at, set upon; pres. subj. 3 pl. mid., after εἴ περ ἂν
στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); fem. acc. pl.
στίχες: στίξ — rank, line of men; fem. nom. pl.
στείχειν: στείχω — go, march; pres. inf., after ἔασκε: ’to go’
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’)
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. acc. sg. · also relative, ’whom, which’; accented before an enclitic · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that’ (τήν γε μάχην ’that battle’)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
τίθησι: τίθημι — put, set, establish; pres. 3 sg.: ’sets, puts’
ταρβήσας: ταρβέω — be afraid, fear; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with οὐ: ’unafraid’ · also without a negative: ’terrified’ (ταρβήσας χαλκόν ’terrified by the bronze’)
ταῦθ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (ταῦθ’ = ταῦτα): ’these things’
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα)
τεύχεσι: τεῦχος — (pl.) armour, gear; neut. dat. pl.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’)
τιθέντες: τίθημι — put, place, lay on; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’laying on’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’)
τρυφάλεια: τρυφάλεια — helmet (origin of the word not known); fem. nom. sg.
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
τυδεΐδῃ: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. dat. sg. (patronymic)
τυπεὶς: τύπτω — strike; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’struck, wounded’
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
τόξα: τόξον — bow; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single bow)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τόφρ: τόφρα — so long, during that time; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’as long as’, elided (τόφρ’ = τόφρα)
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’until’
τύμβῳ: τύμβος — burial mound, tomb; masc. dat. sg.
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’)
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., also + gen.: ’far from’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’)
υἷε: υἱός — son; masc. nom. dual: ’two sons’
φάλαγγες: φάλαγξ — battle-line, line of battle; fem. nom. pl.
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φθισήνορα: φθισήνωρ — man-destroying (φθίνω + ἀνήρ); masc. acc. sg., with πόλεμον
φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. acc. sg.
φόβος: Φόβος — Terror, Rout personified (cf. φόβος ’flight, fear’); masc. nom. sg.
φώς: φώς — man, hero (poetic word); masc. nom. sg.
χαλκός: χαλκός — bronze; masc. nom. sg., also the bronze blade or spear-head
χρεὼ: χρεώ — need, necessity; fem. nom. sg. (indeclinable), with ἐστί understood, + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need (for X of Y)’
χροὸς: χρώς — skin, flesh; masc. gen. sg., epic χροός (= Attic χρωτός)
χρόα: χρώς — skin, flesh, complexion; masc. acc. sg. χρόα
ψυχῆς: ψυχή — life, breath of life, soul; fem. gen. sg.
ἀΐσσονται: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, stream; pres. 3 pl. mid./dep. (Attic ᾄττω): ’stream, fly’
ἀάσατο: ἀάω — bewilder, cloud the mind; aor. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’was bewildered’
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀκήριον: ἀκήριος — spiritless, faint-hearted (ἀ- + κῆρ ’heart’; the sense is inferred); neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέος
ἀκόντων: ἄκων — javelin, dart; masc. gen. pl.
ἀλέγω: ἀλέγω — care for, heed (mostly with a negative); pres. 1 sg., + gen.
ἀλέξανδρος: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἀλεγεινή: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; fem. nom. sg.
ἀλεύατο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἠλεύατο): ’avoided’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
ἀμπεπαλὼν: ἀναπάλλω — swing up, brandish; aor. 2 part. act., masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, ἀμ- by assimilation of ἀνά
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj. of two endings, acc. sg. (masc./fem.) · also neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἀντίβιον: ἀντίβιος — opposed, face to face; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially: ’in open opposition’
ἀντιβολήσας: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having met’
ἀνόρουσε: ἀνορούω — spring up, leap up; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἀνώρουσε)
ἀπάνευθ: ἀπάνευθε(ν) — apart, aside, at a distance; adv., elided (ἀπάνευθ’ = ἀπάνευθε)
ἀπέλεθρον: ἀπέλεθρος — immense, boundless; masc./fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἶν’: ’immeasurable’
ἀπηύρα: ἀπαυράω — take away, rob, deprive of; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with the ending -α: ’took away’
ἀπούρας: ἀπαυράω — take away from, rob of; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. ἀπούρας (a defective verb)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀσπιστάων: ἀσπιστής — shield-bearer; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἦγον): ’were leading’
ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἄκρην: ἄκρος — at the end, topmost, outermost; fem. acc. sg.: ’at its end’
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv.
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency; with the subj. = future contingency, ’perhaps, may’ · also with the opt., potential: ’would, could’ (οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ’you could not carry off anything’) · also ὅτ’ ἄν + subj., ’whenever’ (= ὅταν) · also ἀνά with apocope (ἄν τε μάχην = ἀνά τε μάχην): ’up, through’ + acc.
ἄνδρε: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. dual: ’two men’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἅλιον: ἅλιος — vain, to no purpose; masc. acc. sg., predicative with πόνον: ’vain’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’vain’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive: ’vain’ · also neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’vain’ (ἅλιον βέλος ’a vain shaft’) · also neut. nom. sg., attributive: ’vain’ (οὐχ ἅλιον βέλος ’not a vain shaft’)
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐγγὺς: ἐγγύς — near, close by; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκάλυψεν: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable; with περί in tmesis, ’wrapped round’
ἐλαυνέμεν: ἐλαύνω — drive; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐλαύνειν): ’to drive’
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνάριζον: ἐναρίζω — slay, strip of armour; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἠνάριζον)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξενάριζεν: ἐξεναρίζω — strip of arms, despoil, slay; impf. 3 sg. act., ν-movable: ’was stripping’
ἐξενάριξε: ἐξεναρίζω — slay and strip of arms; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’killed and stripped’
ἐξενάριξεν: ἐξεναρίζω — strip of arms, kill and despoil; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’killed and stripped’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’)
ἐπάλμενος: ἐφάλλομαι — leap upon, spring at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., syncopated (ἐπάλμενος = ἐφαλόμενος): ’leaping on (them)’
ἐπέτελλε: ἐπιτέλλω — lay charge on, enjoin (+ dat. + inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’laid charge’
ἐπαΐσσων: ἐπαΐσσω — rush at, dart upon; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., with dat. of the weapon: ’rushing at (him)’
ἐπιγράψας: ἐπιγράφω — scratch on, mark; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having scratched (his mark)’
ἐπιτάρροθός: ἐπιτάρροθος — helper, ally (one who runs to a cry for help); noun, masc. nom. sg., predicate
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain)
ἐρείσατο: ἐρείδω — prop, lean, support; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἠρείσατο): ’propped himself’
ἐριπὼν: ἐρείπω — throw down; aor. ἤριπον fall headlong; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having crashed down’
ἐρύσατο: ἐρύομαι — ward off, save, rescue; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’warded off’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσεύοντο: σεύω — set moving; mid. rush, hasten; impf. 3 pl. mid., epic augment with doubled σ (ἐσσ-): ’rushed’
ἐφόβησε: φοβέω — put to flight, scare; aor. 3 sg. act., gnomic (in a simile): ’puts to flight’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
ἑλέτην: αἱρέω — take, seize; in battle, kill; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic εἱλέτην): ’the two killed’
ἑστάμεναι: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. inf. intrans., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἑστάναι), after χρή: ’to stand’
ἔασ: ἐάω — let be, leave alone; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἔασ’ = ἔασε) · also εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic ἔασι (= Attic εἰσί), elided
ἔασκε: ἐάω — allow, let; impf. 3 sg., iterative -σκε (= Attic εἴα): ’would let’; negated by οὐδέ
ἔβαλ: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔβαλ’ = ἔβαλε): ’struck, hit’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔκφυγε: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέφυγε)
ἔκφυγεν: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’escaped’
ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
ἔμοιγε: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’to me, for my part’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἔχεν: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχεν): ’held’ · also of a feeling, ’seized, gripped’ (θάμβος … ἔχεν ’wonder held (them)’)
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
ἕλκ: ἕλκω — drag, draw, pull; impf. 3 sg. act., elided (ἕλκ’ = ἕλκε), unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’drew’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠϋκόμοιο: ἠΰκομος (= ἐΰκομος) — fair-haired; adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Βρισηΐδος · also agreeing with Ἑλένης: ’fair-haired (Helen)’ · also agreeing with Θέτιδος: ’fair-haired (Thetis)’ · also agreeing with Ἀθηναίης: ’fair-haired (Athena)’ · also agreeing with Ἥρης: ’fair-haired (Hera)’
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly, heartily’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’pleasing’ (φίλον καὶ ἡδύ ’dear and pleasing’)
ἡνιόχῳ: ἡνίοχος — charioteer; masc. dat. sg., with ὑπό: ’under the charioteer’ · also masc. dat. sg., the person charged after ἐπιτέλλω: ’to the charioteer’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’)
ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I came’ · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they came, advanced’
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἤχθετο: ἄχθομαι — be vexed, be distressed, be burdened (from ἄχθος ’load’); impf. 3 sg. mid.-pass., augmented: ’was distressed’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦλθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἦλθ’ = ἦλθε): ’came, went’
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰσχίον: ἰσχίον — hip, hip-joint; neut. acc. sg., with κατά: ’on the hip’
ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱππόδαμον: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; adj., masc. acc. sg., with Κάστορα
ἴδης: Ἴδη — Mount Ida; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἴδης)
ἴλου: Ἶλος — Ilus, a Trojan of an earlier generation, whose tomb stands on the plain; masc. gen. sg.
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
ἶσα: ἴσος — equal; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’equally’
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσεῦ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., single-σ form (Attic Ὀδυσσεῦ)
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀλέσσῃς: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀλέσῃς), after μή: ’you may lose’
ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; neut. acc. sg.: ’a small (prize)’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbially: ’little’ (ὀλίγον … ἐοικότα ’little like’)
ὀμφαλοέσσης: ὀμφαλόεις — bossed, with a central boss (of a shield); fem. gen. sg., -όεσσα in the feminine, agreeing with ἀσπίδος
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὀχθήσας: ὀχθέω — be vexed, be troubled; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’vexed, troubled’
ὁμίλῳ: ὅμιλος — throng, crowd, gathering (esp. of men); masc. dat. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄβριμος: ὄβριμος — mighty, stout, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares · also epithet of Hector: ’mighty’
ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’)
ὑπαὶ: ὑπαί — under; epic lengthened form of ὑπό; prep. + acc. · also adverb, ’underneath, from below’ (ὑπαὶ δὲ ἴδεσκε ’and he would look from under (his brows), downward’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’with’ (ὑπαὶ δείους ’with fear’)
ὑπείροχον: ὑπείροχος — outstanding, pre-eminent (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὑπέροχος): ’pre-eminent over (others)’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὕπερθεν: ὕπερθεν — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὕστερον: ὕστερος — later, latter; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
ὠκὺ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’
ᾔδεε: οἶδα — know; plpf. (impf. in sense) 3 sg., epic ᾔδεε (= Attic ᾔδει): ’knew’
ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’
ῥίγησε: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver (with fear or cold); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐρρίγησε): ’shuddered’
ῥίγιον: ῥίγιον — worse, more grievous; comparative adj. (cf. ῥῖγος ’shudder’), neut. nom. sg., predicate
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
